newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end lower on bearish sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end lower on bearish sentiment.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended lower on Sunday in bearish sentiment sparked by political uncertainty before the February 3 elections, dealers said.

The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index closed 8.86 points, or 0.64 percent, lower at 1,369.71 amid 168 losers and 60 gainers in a provisional turnover of 9.7 million shares compared to 24.1 million on Thursday. The market was closed for the Friday-Saturday weekend.
PSO fell 4.00 rupees to 262, Parke-Davis 5.00 to 540, Millat Tractors 5.00 to 45, HUBCO 0.35 to 31.70 and ICI Pakistan 0.05 to 17.70. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
